instruction: Extract all GPT4 responses from the opened JSON file and copy them into a new Word document called 'gpt4_output.docx' on the Desktop. Format each response as a separate paragraph with blank lines between them. Bold all instances of the word 'Odyssey'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task extracts GPT4 responses from JSON and formats 'Odyssey' with bold. Verified: 6 responses with 7 occurrences of 'Odyssey'.
